oecd_crs_tied.name: All bilateral donors (OECD CRS tied status)
oecd_crs_tied.years: 1995-2024 (status fields filled sparsely before 2005; see coverage)
oecd_crs_tied.method: OECD CRS project-level rows (MD_DIM=DD, FLOW_TYPE=C commitments, PRICE_BASE=V current prices). Kept: MEASURE 11/13/19 (ODA grants, loans, equity) and BIMULTI_CODE 1/3/7/8 (bilateral channels); dropped multilateral outflows (code 4), private donors (measure 30/code 6), Other Official Flows (measure 14) and PSI (measure 60). total_usd = sum OBS_VALUE x 1e6. tied_usd = AMOUNT_TIED + AMOUNT_PARTIALLY_UNTIED; fully_tied_usd and partially_tied_usd give the two parts. no_status_usd = commitments with none of the three amount fields filled; Turkiye, UAE, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia and most non-DAC donors have almost no status, so tied share should be tied/(tied+untied), not tied/total. foreign_usd is null: tying is a rule about who may bid, not a record of who won. A tied amount goes to the donor's own firms by definition of tying; untied may also be won by donor firms. EU Institutions (4EU001) excluded here and reported under eu_crs_tied. Unspecified-recipient rows are in regional, not by_iso3. CRS code XKV recoded to XKX.
oecd_crs_tied.anomalies: 10 donor-recipient-year cells have status amounts over 105% of commitments (excess USD 1094 million, published as filed, not corrected).

eu_crs_tied.name: EU Institutions (OECD CRS tied status)
eu_crs_tied.method: OECD CRS project-level rows (MD_DIM=DD, FLOW_TYPE=C commitments, PRICE_BASE=V current prices). Kept: MEASURE 11/13/19 (ODA grants, loans, equity) and BIMULTI_CODE 1/3/7/8 (bilateral channels); dropped multilateral outflows (code 4), private donors (measure 30/code 6), Other Official Flows (measure 14) and PSI (measure 60). total_usd = sum OBS_VALUE x 1e6. tied_usd = AMOUNT_TIED + AMOUNT_PARTIALLY_UNTIED; fully_tied_usd and partially_tied_usd give the two parts. no_status_usd = commitments with none of the three amount fields filled; Turkiye, UAE, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia and most non-DAC donors have almost no status, so tied share should be tied/(tied+untied), not tied/total. foreign_usd is null: tying is a rule about who may bid, not a record of who won. A tied amount goes to the donor's own firms by definition of tying; untied may also be won by donor firms. Donor 4EU001 only.

idb.name: Inter-American Development Bank
idb.source_title: IDB Project Procurement Contract Awards Data (doi:10.60966/coo0rbyd)
idb.currency: Treated as USD. The dataset never names its currency; largest contract is 474.6 million and yearly sums run 2-6 billion across countries with very weak currencies, which rules out local currency, but the owner should know USD is an inference.
idb.method: All 159,528 rows of the published file (datastore dump). total_usd = sum total_amount by operation_country_name and contract_year; foreign_usd = rows where awarded_firm_country_name differs from operation_country_name; unknown_usd = firm country blank or a non-country code (Central American sub-region, INTAL); idb_financed_usd = sum idb_amount (blank or zero on 77,694 rows, so not complete; total_amount is the usable measure). total_amount is the whole contract, including any co-financing. Includes loans, technical cooperation and grants. Regional operations (REGIONAL, REGIONAL SUPPORT) are in regional, not by_iso3. No lender-own-country figure: a regional bank has no home country. Rows are as published; 5 contract ids have exact repeat rows, left in.

ebrd.name: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development
ebrd.source_title: EBRD Annual Review of Procurement Activities, Annex 1 "Listing of Contracts by Country of Operations", 2016-2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 editions
ebrd.currency: EUR as published; USD = EUR / World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF for EMU, annual average
ebrd.method: Each report's Annex 1 lists public-sector contracts with winner marked (W) and Tenderer Country. total = Signed Contract Value (whole contract, not only the EBRD share). foreign = winner country differs from Op Country. A row 'COUNTRY (W)' marks the winner; if a joint venture marks several, the first is used; if no mark but only one country is listed, that country is used. unknown = no winner country readable. winner_country_check compares winner sums to the report's own table of awards by country of origin, for years where it could be read. Excludes what the bank excludes from Annex 1: Nuclear Safety funds, confidential gas purchases (2023: 109 contracts, EUR 698 million), late-entered contracts (late listings give no contractor country), grant-funded client-led consultancies. 2023 and 2024 listing pages are outlines with no text, so they were read by OCR; a country-year is kept only if the OCR sum is within 0.1% of its printed total, or below it by no more than 5%, with the shortfall put in unknown; others are listed in excluded_country_years (2023 also has Morocco and Montenegro totals unread by OCR, so they are absent). Text-layer years reconcile to the printed grand total to under EUR 200,000 except 2018, where country lines sum EUR 31.2 million above the printed total. No lender-own-country figure: multilateral. Current-year rolling list (Public Sector Signed Contracts as of November 2026) not used because 2026 has no EUR rate yet and the year is not complete.

aiib.name: Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank
aiib.source_title: AIIB project procurement, contract award notices (ppo-data list and notice PDFs)
aiib.currency: USD; other currencies converted by World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF annual average of the year; items with no rate for the year (mainly 2026) dropped and counted
aiib.partial_reason: PARTIAL SAMPLE. 277 published notices only, not all AIIB-financed contracts: AIIB publishes notices for selected contracts, and co-financed projects run by the World Bank or ADB are on those banks’ sites. Firm country read from 145 notices (710 contract lines); 132 notices had scanned, zipped, missing or unformatted files, and their index price goes to unknown_usd. 18 lines could not be converted.
aiib.method: Country of contractor from notice PDF: 'Country' + 'Contract Price' blocks, or the post-review table 'Country of Contractor' + 'Contract Price in USD Equivalent'. foreign = contractor country differs from borrowing member named in the list. Not usable as a share of AIIB lending.

gaps.reason: Data exists but could not be read. ADB publishes 'Procurement by Nationality 2014-2024' (XLSX, contractor nationality, per contract), landing page readable through WebFetch but file links not shown; data.adb.org answers 403 from the shell. The search behind www.adb.org/projects/tenders was not used: looking through the site's scripts for its search access was stopped by the session's permission check, and no way around it was tried. Annual-report tables on data.adb.org give only cumulative totals by member, no borrower split. If the owner downloads the XLSX by hand, it can be processed.

Listing files of awarded contracts exist (2011-2016, 2012-2017, 2013-2018 XLS/XLSX; fields not confirmed), and individual award notices among 13,189 procurement documents. www.afdb.org refuses the shell (403) and WebFetch failed on the listing file and its page. Not read.

No dataset of contract awards with contractor country found. The bank says promoters run procurement and it is not party to the contracts. It posts notices for projects outside the EU and award-notice templates, but the pages read do not give awards, values or winners in a form that can be totalled. EU-side rows naming the EIB in the FTS are funds passed to the bank, not contracts.

OECD CRS has a code for officially supported export credits (measure 22) but returned no rows when queried for 2019. No country-level foreign-firm data read for any agency. Export credits by design back the agency’s home exporters, so a foreign/own split would not add information; the missing figure is the amount per borrower. Not attempted agency by agency.

Tied status is the only cross-donor measure. No common dataset gives winners’ country by recipient. JICA, USAID and others were not read at contract level. CRS also has private-sector and OOF rows, left out of the tied measure.

Reachable (datastore.iati.cloud answered), but not used. It has a default tied-status code (48,371 activities coded tied) and receiver organisations, no firm home country. It is self-reported, double-counts money passed between publishers, and repeats what CRS holds for the same donors. A total by recipient would be weaker than CRS.
Those listing pages have no text; OCR did not reproduce the printed country total within 0.1%. See lenders.ebrd.excluded_country_years.
